source.scope: store-wide (NOT product-scoped) — an order belongs to Organic if its same rule as salesuk.js: Direct / Referral (any) / No Journey Data / whitelisted Organic Search sources / Social-Pinterest / Other-ChatGPT-or-unknown-source.. Order-level rows (no per-product breakdown) with full session history. Groups are checked in a fixed priority order (DM-Ad -> Meta -> Sonya -> Sajeepan -> Sukirtha -> Organic -> CPPC -> Thishoban -> Theekshy -> Thanishtika) so no order can appear in more than one group's tab. 2025 backfill using the exact same rules already confirmed on salesuk.html for 2026 — built 2026-07-29.
